authorization.text: 版本号 v0.7.7，授权上线；上线后先刷新这个 Canvas 验证 0 次多余保存，再真实执行一次，验证无误报、无 409、无重复提交。
authorization.versionConvention: Ordinary patch release v0.7.7; no hotfix suffix.

rootCause: Authoritative text success left stale standalone-recovery input and ownership keys on seven text nodes, causing one unnecessary Canvas PUT per text node after refresh.

All four node recovery effects could continue while the server workflow had already locked the node but before workflowExecutionRunId was projected, so a late old-task result could race the workflow save, return 409 and show a false read-failure alert.

fix: Clear textGenerationInputKey and textGenerationOwnershipKey in authoritative text-success projection while retaining task identity and complete workflow success proof.
Treat either an authoritative server workflow lock or an existing workflowExecutionRunId as a hard stop for stale single-node recovery.
Abort and lifecycle-fence in-flight stale recovery for text, image, video and audio when that workflow lock arrives.

verification.safeM103ServerWorkflow: 11/11 PASS on the unchanged v0.7.7 server projection change; text success clears both stale standalone-recovery keys and retains task/proof fields.
verification.safeM41GenerationRetryUi: 59/59 PASS; four dynamic browser cases prove a late abort-ignoring old-task success cannot save, submit, contact a Provider or show the false polling warning after the server workflow lock arrives.
verification.safeM81DeploymentHardening: 42/42 PASS; v0.7.7 is an exact final release identity and v0.7.7-hotfix.1 is rejected.
verification.formalFull: NOT_REPEATED; risk-driven targeted evidence only, because this patch changes the Canvas recovery/projection seam and the release identity, not the broader application contract.
verification.governanceM38: Final 19/19 PASS. The first two runs each passed 18/19 and exposed only current-authority marker drift; the exact documentation markers were corrected, then the affected spec passed without product-code changes.

review.requiredCoverage: Every changed file and diff hunk; text success projection, all four recovery effects, dynamic lock-arrival race, version identity, current authority documents and both receipts.
review.finalCoverage: 26/26 tracked changed files, 65/65 tracked diff hunks and 2/2 untracked receipts; text projection, all four recovery effects, dynamic race tests, version identity, runner inventory, source-coverage manifest, current authority documents and receipts were reviewed read-only.

orderedGates: Instrument the logged-in Chrome tab, refresh once, and observe zero Canvas PUT, zero 409, zero workflow or task POST and no false task-read alert.
Only after the refresh gate passes, click the exact group execute control once.
Prove exactly one workflow create and at most one task, admission and Provider attempt per logical node, with no duplicate submission.
Prove all 11 workflow nodes settle successfully, results remain visible and a final clean refresh produces zero redundant Canvas PUT.
